p4_b0.ocr: In recent years, the electronic materials market has experienced significant fluctuations, particularly in North America, where demand for advanced materials continues to rise alongside growing sustainability concerns.

p4_b1.ocr: A critical component of this landscape is the revenue generated from electronic materials, which saw an increase from $150M in 2019 to $190M in 2021. This growth has been accompanied by a heightened focus on plastic recycling rates, which are essential for mitigating environmental impact.

p4_b4.ocr: This context highlights not only the financial aspects of the electronic materials sector but also the environmental implications tied to plastic waste management.
